flow: feedback area expands (mobile: focused sheet, sticky SEND above keyboard)
SEND REVISION REQUEST enabled only when valid
submitted → status REVISION_REQUESTED → workspace receives → family returns to active production → HOME stops showing it as waiting on client
founder posts new version → client notified REVISION READY → review shows WHAT YOU SAID · WHAT CHANGED · NEW VERSION

follow_ups_optional: WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO FEEL DIFFERENT?

validation_contract.rule: IF decision = NEEDS_REVISION THEN comment must be meaningful — enforced on CLIENT and SERVER (server currently accepts empty).
validation_contract.min_meaningful: trimmed comment ≥ 12 characters AND ≥ 3 words; OR ≥ 1 chip + trimmed comment ≥ 6 characters
validation_contract.error_copy: TELL US A LITTLE MORE SO WE CAN FIX THE RIGHT THING.

unsaved_feedback: Draft autosaved per review (server draft or local draft keyed by user+review); leaving with text shows KEEP DRAFT / DISCARD.

client_view_if_scope_change: THIS REQUEST CHANGES THE APPROVED SCOPE.

analytics_internal_only: time waiting on client vs founder
